_comment: StreetTracker live RTSP config. Copy to configs/camera.json
(gitignored) and fill in the password before running the tracker.
Schema mirrors NanoTracker's camera_config.json so an existing
Nano deploy can be migrated by scp alone.
_nano_compat_comment: Legacy NanoTracker decoder hints. preferred_stream selects which
stream entry feeds inference (sub keeps GPU + RAM low on Jetson).

inference._engine_path_comment: Built on-device via `streettracker export-engine`. NOT portable across GPU archs.

tracking._comment: iou_match_threshold + max_misses kept for parity; BotSORT reads its own yaml.

output._html_idle_seconds_comment: Regenerate HTML when no tracks active for this many seconds.

http._comment: Built-in dashboard. http://<orin-ip>:8080/ for live LAN access.

_comment: Reolink 4K HTTP snapshot fetcher. Fires on snap_planner crossings;
saves to vehicle_<id>_main_<N>.jpg for downstream ALPR.
_snap_gate_comment: triggers. Forward (R->L approach, front plate) fires on small
t' values; reverse (L->R depart, rear plate) fires on large.
See CLAUDE.md `Snap gate` section for the artifact pipeline.
